Here is your complete **Dune 3 IMAX Ticket Radar & Poller** for **District (by Zomato)** and **BookMyShow (BMS)**, ready to host 100% free in the cloud so you get notified the second tickets drop.

You can preview the live web app here:
👉 **[Open Arrakis Radar Web Dashboard](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/5bb2e433-9e8d-4222-bbcf-f831ae6d9580/832fb02ac2c9c49e2c256a41/)**

---

### What Was Built

1. **[index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html)**:
   - **Cinematic Dune-inspired Dashboard** featuring real-time radar sweep animation and telemetry monitors.
   - **Targeting Controls**: City selector (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, etc.), movie search keywords, and format toggles (IMAX Laser 1.43:1, IMAX 70mm, 4DX, ICE).
   - **Live Scanners & Simulators**: 
     - **Test Siren**: Web Audio synthesizer that sounds like the Hans Zimmer Dune horn + IMAX emergency siren.
     - **Simulate Drop**: Triggers a mock ticket drop to verify audio, visual banner, and desktop push alerts.
     - **Instant Test Pingers**: One-click test alerts for Telegram, ntfy.sh, and Discord directly from your browser.
2. **[poller.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/poller.js)** (Node.js) & **[poller.py](file:///home/agent/workspace/poller.py)** (Python 3):
   - Standalone poller scripts built with **zero external dependencies** (pure standard library).
   - Live query engine that scans 430+ titles on **District** (`district.in`) and **BookMyShow** (`in.bookmyshow.com`), parses cinema venues and IMAX formats, checks booking status (`Book tickets` / `Available` / `Filling Fast`), and sends alerts.
3. **[.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml](file:///home/agent/workspace/.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml)**:
   - **100% Free Forever Cloud Poller**: A pre-configured GitHub Actions cron workflow that runs automatically in GitHub's cloud every 5 minutes around the clock—no local machine needed.
4. **[worker.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/worker.js)**:
   - Alternative serverless edge poller for Cloudflare Workers (100,000 requests/day free tier).
5. **[README.md](file:///home/agent/workspace/README.md)** & **[package.json](file:///home/agent/workspace/package.json)**:
   - Full setup guides for Telegram bots, Discord webhooks, and ntfy.sh push notifications.

---

### How to Host It 100% Free (Recommended: GitHub Actions)

To let it run autonomously 24/7 without keeping your computer on:

1. **Connect your repository**: Tap the **GitHub mark at the top of the chat** to connect a repository — your entire project code and commit history will be pushed there automatically.
2. **Set your notification secrets**:
   In your new GitHub repository, go to **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret** and add:
   - `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` & `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` (from `@BotFather` and `@userinfobot`)
   - Or `NTFY_TOPIC`: A secret topic name (e.g. `dune3-imax-radar-xyz`) for the free **ntfy** mobile app (iOS & Android) — no signup required!
   - `CITY`: e.g. `bengaluru`, `mumbai`, `delhi-ncr`, etc.
   - `MOVIE_KEYWORD`: `dune`
3. **That's it!** GitHub Actions will execute [.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml](file:///home/agent/workspace/.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml) every 5 minutes and ping your phone the moment tickets appear.

### Run It Locally Anytime

```bash
# Run a single sweep check
node poller.js --once

# Send a test alert to your phone
node poller.js --test-alert

# Run continuous background loop
node poller.js
```

Yes! It's completely built and live. You can open and test it right now:

👉 **[Open Arrakis Radar Web App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/5bb2e433-9e8d-4222-bbcf-f831ae6d9580/832fb02ac2c9c49e2c256a41/)**

### What’s Ready For You:
1. **Interactive Web Dashboard** ([index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html)):
   - Live radar sweep for **District** and **BookMyShow** across Indian IMAX cities (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, etc.).
   - Built-in **Hans Zimmer Dune Horn & IMAX Siren** acoustic synthesizer.
   - **Simulate Drop** button to preview how ticket notifications trigger.
   - 1-click test alert pings for **Telegram**, **ntfy.sh (free phone push)**, and **Discord**.
2. **Dual-Platform Poller Engine** ([poller.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/poller.js) & [poller.py](file:///home/agent/workspace/poller.py)):
   - Actively scrapes District's catalog (430+ titles) and BMS explore listings with zero dependencies, parses IMAX formats, and detects open bookings.
3. **100% Free 24/7 Cloud Poller** ([.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml](file:///home/agent/workspace/.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml)):
   - Scheduled to run on GitHub Actions every 5 minutes in the cloud so you don't have to keep your computer awake.
   - To activate the 24/7 cloud poller, **tap the GitHub mark at the top of the chat** to connect a repository — your entire project and workflow will go there automatically!

To push this project to your GitHub, simply **tap the GitHub mark (icon) at the top of the chat** to connect your repository. 

Your entire project, files, and complete commit history will automatically sync there as soon as you connect it!

Once connected, your scheduled 24/7 ticket watcher in [.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml](file:///home/agent/workspace/.github/workflows/dune-imax-poller.yml) will be live in your repo.
